messages.subject: recordTable ignores pictures
parts:
Hi Jurgen,
I am getting a warning when trying to read in photos using the recordTable() function:
"found 189 files beginning with '._' in ... Will ignore them."
I checked and there are no file names that begin with '._'
Do the photos have to have a specific name to be read in properly by camtrapR?
Thanks!
Rahel

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: recordTable ignores pictures
parts:
Hi Rahel,
do you or did someone else handle the data on a Mac? And then maybe move to a different OS? These files beginning with "._" are hidden files on Macs.which containing additional information about files and metadata which are supported by the Mac file system but not supported onthe volume's file systems;

In other words, nothing to worry about. I should turn that warning into a note, so this doesn't scare users.

For more info see here: 
https://lists.apple.com/archives/applescript-users/2006/Jun/msg00180.html

To answer the other question, no, camtrapR does not require a particular file name to rename properly. Just don't let the files begin with "._". Also, don't manually add double underscores ("__") to files names. imageRename() does that to separate different pieces of information in file names. These double underscores are user by other functions like recordTable to access those information again.

Best regards,
Jürgen
